<b>Broodfeast</b> is a [[Hunt Wishes|Hunt Wish]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>, started by speaking to [[Huntress]] at her den in [[Putrified Ducts]].

== Wish ==
Huntress needs to stockpile meat to feed her brood of eggs before they hatch and devour her out of hunger instead. She asks [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] to collect 3 types of organs for her by killing organic enemies in various ways. Almost every non-mechanical enemy in the game is compatible with this Wish.

If Hornet fails to complete <i>Broodfeast</i> before [[Act 3]], Huntress is devoured by her own offspring, and the Wish is replaced by the functionally identical <i>[[Runtfeast]]</i> after speaking to [[Runt]].

15 [[Seared Organ]]s can be obtained by roasting enemies using fiery or electrical attacks:

* [[Needle]] after using [[Flintslate]]
* [[Pimpillo]]
* [[Wispfire Lantern]]
* [[Voltvessels]]
* Other sources of heat (e.g. a [[Memoria]] blown up by another Memoria's electrified explosive)

35 [[Shredded Organ]]s can be harvested by tearing up enemies using jagged weapons:

* [[Sawtooth Circlet]]
* [[Cogwork Wheel]]
* [[Delver's Drill]]
* [[Conchcutter]]
* [[Beast Crest]]'s downwards attack
* [[Architect Crest]]'s downwards and [[Needle Strike]] attacks

10 [[Skewered Organ]]s can be gathered by stabbing or impaling enemies with:

* [[Sting Shard]] 
* [[Longpin]]
* [[Needle Phial]]

== Reward ==
[[File:Longclaw.png|link=Longclaw|left|frameless|50px]]
Upon bringing all 60 organs to [[Huntress]], she rewards Hornet with the [[Longclaw]].

{{Clear}}

== Trivia ==
* Despite not dying or appearing seriously wounded, defeating [[Garmond & Zaza]] with the appropriate damage will also drop the respective Organ if the Wish is active.
